events.event_name: Printemps New York Fall/Winter 2026 Fashion Show
events.address: Printemps New York, 1 Wall St, New York, NY 10005
events.what_it_is: A one-hour Fall/Winter 2026 runway presentation in Printemps New York's Red Room, followed by the opportunity to shop featured looks from the show.
events.what_is_free: The official Printemps booking page lists the event price as $0 for the one-hour fashion show.
events.caveats: Printemps' current first-party event page lists September 19, 5–6 PM in the Red Room, price $0, and a live booking flow. Advance booking is therefore treated as the advertised admission path. No organizer-approval language was found.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 19 from 5–6 PM at Printemps New York, 1 Wall Street. Use the official Printemps event page to reserve the $0 one-hour event before traveling.

occurrences.details: Free advance booking through the official Printemps event page; no approval requirement established.
